name: Hengbao Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hengbao Co.,Ltd. engages in the fintech, internet of things, certificate and identity security, access management, intelligent identification, and digital and data services in China and internationally. The company offers card payment and security services; blockchain finance, digital asset wallet, and supply chain financial platform; mobile communications and the internet of things, including sim, esim, and M2M card. It also provides smart password keys, electronic token, Bluetooth USBKEY, mobile smart terminal mobile phone shield, and other products; and tax security products, such as tax control disk and transmission disk, and tax U-key.
